text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—I won't lose. —I won't.
My "friend" is still so far away...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha, nice! Nice!
It's way better than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (I hear it—the breath of life!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Catch me! If you can catch me,
just try and do it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—! It's time.
—From here on.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (Every single one of 'em is fired up and swaggering! This is the Twinkle Series I've been waiting for!)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I can catch up—I know I can!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Today's the day—into the light!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: But—!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The one who's gonna win is MEEEEEE!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket!
She blows right past the rest!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
No mercy! No contest!
If you've beaten a lineup like this,
that's absolute proof of your strength!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: O-Ooooh...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (Right, this is it, they're the ones...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(I never wanted to bask in victory
with no one around to see it.)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (Fuji-san... Tsuzuki...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (Tachyon... Cafe...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's surviving and rising to the top...
And new Umamusume keep appearing one after another...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: In a place like that, I just wanted to win, purely and simply.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(I don't need any more cries of frustration or mourning.
That's right—)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The strongest—is me!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A roar! A shout of fury!
A soulful roar shaking Nakayama—no, the entire nation!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This isn't a miracle anymore!
Jungle Pocket is undeniably the strongest!
The Umamusume everyone acknowledges as the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Partner...
choice_data_list: Looks like you're... all right now.
Looks like you're... all right now.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hmm... You okay?
choice_data_list: The condition of your legs. Once you recover, you won't fall apart.
The condition of your legs. Once you recover, you won't fall apart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is Jungle Pocket's trait.
As the type whose good and bad form both last a long time, once she recovers, she won't easily falter.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, no need to worry.
After all—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Because right now—I'm the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "The strongest"... Plenty of folks laughed at that. It might've been a distant dream, sure. But—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We did it, partner! You and me!
Who could ever beat us?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A beast striving to be the strongest, and myself, enchanted by it. The dream has become reality.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, quite well done.
Congratulations, Pokke-kun.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I couldn't pull away from her, at least for today.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon... Cafe...
You bastards are all right, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it seems to have held up somehow.
From here on out, even further... bit by bit...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In other words—I was saved.
By your sheer vitality.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: My... vitality?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Indeed. It was thanks to your rigorous, relentless training that Tsuzuki-kun managed to survive."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And that Tsuduki-kun was the one
who connected our potential together.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Your wild vitality. That is what
created a path that was neither Plan A nor Plan B.
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A double helix, a spiral! To think that one strand is instinct itself.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I still have no damn clue what
you're talking about as usual. But—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "Instinct? Well, duh. What can someone do if their heart ain't on fire?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I will never yield—not now, not ever—!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone! This long era of conflict
has gone on long enough, but it ends right now.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Did you see it?! Today's brawl!
Everyone gave it everything they had—and you saw who won!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: From here on out—it's MY era!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm not the guy who was chasing after someone anymore.
From here on out—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"The champion, Jungle Pocket,
is gonna close out the Twinkle Series!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Here, the universally recognized new headliner
of the Twinkle Series was born.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Jungle Pocket.
She may look like an Umamusume, but running through her veins—
is the hybrid blood of wild beasts.
